city.title: City
city.description: City the visitor is looking in, e.g. Indore. Partial names are matched.

configuration.title: Configuration (BHK)
configuration.description: One BHK configuration exactly as stored on the property, e.g. 2 BHK, 3 BHK, Penthouse. Leave blank to return all configurations.

priceMax.title: Price (Max)
priceMax.description: Upper end of the budget in INR. Leave blank for no upper limit.

priceMin.title: Price (Min)
priceMin.description: Lower end of the budget in INR. Leave blank to start from 0.
